decoder_scope: Existing d4 audit.rs and sentry.rs reused byte-for-byte. New wrapper is separately produced; it did not execute original d4 correctness. Future timing can use the same verifier-capable producing driver.
limitations: Exporter HTTP headers and raw HTTP client wire were runtime-validated but were not retained by the original producer. Offline replay verifies actual recorded protobuf/Sentry bodies, derived span inventory, goldens, outcome hashes, assets and logs; it does not fabricate missing wire.
Old SDK Sentry propagation context alone does not establish correlation with the OTLP terminal-failure trace. Final signed-role validation remains separate.
